results.content: The arts and humanities focus on the human experience—across time and place—scholars and artists analyze our expansive past and shared future across a wide range of disciplines. Serving as the university’s gateway for exploring cultural connections across borders, identities and time, the Department of Africana and American Studies operates in a unique niche between theory and practice, research and social engagement, and humanity and the environment. We unite the disciplines of fine art, design and emerging practices with art history and visual theory to equip students with an interdisciplinary approach to investigating and creating the visual world. The Department of Global Gender and Sexuality Studies promotes critical thinking and understanding of today's diverse, multicultural world through research and teaching on feminism, women, gender and sexuality. The mission of the Department of Media Study is to conduct research and provide educational programs in film and media production as well as theory.
